newsitem.title: CHINA: HK markets watchdog revokes registration of trader.
newsitem.headline: HK markets watchdog revokes registration of trader.

text.p: Hong Kong's markets watchdog said on Thursday it had revoked the registration of a former dealer's representative of Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd's Hong Kong unit because of misconduct.

The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) said in a statement it had revoked the registration of Chia Neil, a former dealer's representative of Yamaichi International (H.K.) Ltd, as a securities dealer's representative.
Chia was found guilty of misconduct because his acts were prejudicial to the interests of the investing public, the SFC said.

An SFC inquiry found Chia, as a dealer's representative of Yamaichi International, had effected trades in a client's account without the client's prior knowledge or authorisation, which resulted in substantial loss to the client.
Yamaichi dismissed Chia last Septebmer upon discovery of his misconduct, and had made full compensation to the client for his loss, the SFC said.
